coverage.cached_truth_scope: Existing physical-policy cache union within each geometry only.

targets.interpretation: 24 geometry units; repeated candidate exposures and three streams are descriptive counts, not independent samples.

reused_general_error_results.scope: Stage61 general objective-difference MSE and raw comparisons retained at their existing path; not recalculated.

definitions.scoring: Original unused two repeats at final13 policies; all three at never-observed3, even when scoring prefix10.
definitions.eligible: Saved probability_violation <=0.5; paired comparisons use the symmetric intersection of the two arms.
definitions.empirical_feasibility: Unused g mean + normal quantile times sample standard deviation <=0; not a certificate.
definitions.near_gap: Stage61 lowest ceil(pair_count/4) absolute unused-label gaps within case/current-prefix/pair-group, before eligibility filtering.
definitions.relative_optimism: For observed i/unobserved j, (predicted f_i-f_j)-(unused-label f_i-f_j); positive means unobserved j relatively optimistic.
definitions.selection: Descriptive minimum objective mean within a saved eligibility mask, not actual optimizer acquisition or certified deployment.
definitions.statistical_unit: Source group first; 24 overlapping archive/fold/family groups, not 24 independent tasks.
definitions.ties: Exact zero label gaps are excluded from sign error; predicted ties on an untied label count as wrong. Paired changes <=1e-12 are descriptive ties.

limits: Only saved marginal uncertainty exists; cross-policy covariance, posterior difference variance and ordering confidence remain unknown.
Two or three unused repeats give noisy source labels, not exact objective truth or safety certificates.
d50 source holdouts do not establish d1000 adaptive-selection performance; the source histories are fixed.
No correction or weight sweep is evaluated. Evidence may motivate a later unique change, but this audit does not validate one.

statistical_unit: 24 fixed geometries; streams are separated, not 72 independent confirmation tasks. Reuse existing Stage65/67 inference unchanged.
limits: Fixed-state mean selection is diagnostic, not a new optimizer or certified outcome.
Cached policy union is selected by realized histories, not a complete candidate truth dataset.
Source holdout labels are empirical and folds overlap; no source joint draws or contrast covariance are invented.
All controls and historical losses stay in Stage68 references; target scores cover the three saved roles only.
No target-truth selection of a correction, threshold, temperature or ensemble weight.
